name: My Mini App Launcher
description: Save HTML mini apps to your browser and launch them in one click. All stored locally, never sent anywhere.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://unpkg.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://cdn.tailwindcss.com https://esm.sh https://ajax.googleapis.com; child-src 'self';
